profile.headline: Senior Android Engineer | Kotlin | Android SDK | MVVM | Clean Architecture | Fintech (40M+ users) | Mobile Security (E2EE)
profile.summary:
Senior Android Engineer with 8+ years of experience building secure, high-scale mobile applications used by tens of millions of users, primarily in fintech environments.
At PicPay, I led the implementation of end-to-end encryption (E2EE) for peer-to-peer communication, impacting over 40 million users and strengthening platform security at scale.
I also contributed to the development of mobile banking applications used by more than 10 million users, focusing on performance, reliability, and secure architecture.
My expertise includes Kotlin, modern Android development (MVVM, Clean Architecture), dependency injection (Koin/Dagger), and modularized architectures for scalable mobile systems.
More recently, I’ve been expanding my experience into backend and cloud systems to better support mobile platforms end-to-end.
Currently based in the U.S. with permanent work authorization (Green Card), and actively exploring opportunities as a Senior Android Engineer.
Technologies: Kotlin, Android SDK, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Coroutines, REST APIs, CI/CD, Jetpack Compose.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Mobile & Platform)
positions.description:
Working on the development of a mobile application and its supporting platform systems in a fast-paced startup environment.

Acting on the front line of mobile development, focusing on application architecture, performance, and user experience.

Building and evolving mobile features using Angular and Capacitor, ensuring scalability and maintainability.

Designing and developing backend services and APIs using .NET and Microsoft Azure to support mobile-driven use cases.

Contributing across mobile and backend layers, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end product features.

Participating in system design decisions, code reviews, and CI/CD pipelines to improve code quality and deployment consistency.
positions.insights: Mobile Applications, Android Development and +8 skills

positions.title: Staff Android Engineer
positions.description:
Led the design and implementation of end-to-end encryption (E2EE) for peer-to-peer chat, securing communication for over 40 million users.

Developed secure encryption layers within the Android SDK using Android Keystore, modern cryptographic standards, and modularized architecture.

Designed secure communication flows between mobile and backend systems, ensuring data confidentiality and integrity.

Collaborated with backend and security teams to integrate E2EE without compromising performance or user experience.

Contributed to architectural decisions for scalable and secure mobile systems in a high-traffic fintech environment.
positions.insights: Android Development, Software Architecture and +12 skills

positions.title: Senior Android Engineer
positions.description:
Developed features for a large-scale mobile banking platform used by millions of users for financial transactions.

Built scalable Android components using Kotlin, MVVM, REST APIs, and modularized architecture, ensuring maintainability and scalability.

Improved application stability and maintainability through clean architecture and best engineering practices.

Contributed to CI/CD pipelines, supporting reliable builds and automated deployments.

Worked closely with product, design, and backend teams in an Agile environment.

positions.title: Senior Android Engineer
positions.description:
Led the migration of web-based features to native Android, expanding mobile product capabilities.

Improved application security by implementing root detection, secure JWT handling, and data protection practices.

Monitored and improved app stability using Firebase Crashlytics and release management processes.

Managed app releases and deployment pipelines using Bitrise and Play Console.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver secure and performant mobile features.

Implemented dependency injection using Koin, improving modularity and maintainability of the codebase.

positions.title: Android Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained mobile banking applications used by over 10 million users.

Delivered features focused on performance, reliability, and secure transactions.

Built scalable Android components using Kotlin and Java with MVVM, Dagger, and modularized architecture.

Improved code reliability through unit testing (JUnit, Mockito) and CI/CD pipelines.

Worked in Agile teams contributing to continuous delivery and product improvements.

Worked on performance optimization and app reliability in high-scale mobile environments.

Worked on large-scale modularized Android architecture, improving team scalability and code maintainability.
